text:
praveen: :rotating_light: seeing a p99 jump to ~1.4s on /v1/generate across gpu-cluster-5 starting ~09:17 UTC. Latency correlates with KV cache eviction spikes and a kernel fallback to cpu-kernel-2

marta: which tenants? any deploys around that time?

deployer-bot: deploy notice — prod/gpu-cluster-5 sha=abc123 PR=#4567 rolled at 2024-04-15T09:12:43Z (release windows: default)

praveen: heavy traffic from tenant alpha (bursting shorter seqs). flamegraph link: https://internal.redwood/fg/alpha-171500 — shows long tail in cpu-kernel-2 kernel path + lots of cache misses

incident-bot: incident created: IN-2024-04215-1 — perf spike on gpu-cluster-5. Priority: P2. Pager: on-call infra

amy: my hunch: autoswitch kernel selection fallback triggered due to ephemeral mem pressure -> switched to slower kernel, plus KV eviction caused batching to become less effective. Can we flip adaptive-kernel-autoswitch -> off for cluster-5?

kevin: if we flip it, we should also throttle the alpha tenant QPS to avoid immediate overload. propose set per-tenant throttle to 60% of baseline for 15m.

praveen: agree. I'm going to apply two actions: 1) feature-flag off, 2) quick throttle for tenant alpha, 3) reduce max batch size to 16 on cluster-5.

praveen: feature flag toggle (control plane):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://control-plane.internal/flags/adaptive-kernel-autoswitch/cluster-5 \
  -d '{"enabled":false, "actor":"praveen", "note":"temp mitigation IN-2024-04215-1"}'
```

ops-bot: flag updated: adaptive-kernel-autoswitch for cluster-5 set to OFF by praveen at 2024-04-15T09:23:10Z

praveen: throttle command applied via routing service:
```json
{"action":"throttle","tenant":"alpha","cluster":"gpu-cluster-5","qps_pct":60,"duration_min":15}
```

lucy: I pushed a small change to runtime config to lower max batch size to 16 for cluster-5 (PR #4572). rolling restart in progress.

deployer-bot: rolling restart started for gpu-cluster-5 config change PR=#4572 at 2024-04-15T09:25:02Z

marta: monitor dashboards: p50/p95/p99? any improvement yet?

praveen: after FF off + throttle + batch reduction: p99 down to ~380ms within 3 mins, KV evictions down 72%, CPU kernel time reduced. throughput returned to ~95% baseline.

kevin: routing fallback: moved 20% of alpha -> dedicated-pool-d1 for 20m as safety. command: route policy update applied.

ami: noted — will capture the probe/profile for postmortem: saved perf traces to s3://redwood-internal/perf/IN-2024-04215-1/ (flamegraphs + kernel selection traces).

praveen: temp mitigations in place. leaving incident open for short follow-up and a postmortem. Can someone file the PM? marta?

marta: filing postmortem now, assigning to runtime team + infra. Will include timeline, traces, and suggested long-term fixes: better kernel selection heuristics, KV cache warming, and tenant shaping policies.

incident-bot: incident IN-2024-04215-1 status -> mitigation in place. Next update in 30m or on request.

kevin: small follow-up: recommend a small autoswitch guard to prefer kernel with steady-state cache hit rate > 85% to avoid flip-flops. adding to backlog.

lucy: will revert batch-size change after confirm 1 hour stable; keeping flag off until PM complete.

praveen: thanks all :thumbsup: closing realtime ops — keep alerts open for next 60m, then downgrade.

incident-bot: incident IN-2024-04215-1 marked as MONITORED at 2024-04-15T10:05:00Z
